metadata.name: Get Confident Peaks From ATAC or CUTandRUN duplicates (release v0.1)
annotations: This workflow takes as input BED from ATAC-seq or CUT&RUN. It calls peaks on each replicate and intersect them. In parallel, each BAM is subsetted to smallest number of reads. Peaks are called using both subsets combined. Only peaks called using a combination of both subsets which have summits intersecting the intersection of both replicates will be kept.
